————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the November 26, 2007/Agrahayana 5, 1929 (Saka)

(Ministries: Earth Sciences; Food Processing Industries; Human Resource
Development; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable
Energy; Power; Science and Technology; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Capacity enhancement of power
projects
†*141. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether various States of the
country are facing acute shortage of power;
(b) whether the capacity of some
projects has not been enhanced for the last
several years, and a number of projects are
still awaiting necessary approval, as a result
of which industrial and agricultural
production in most of the States is on the
decline; and
(c) if so, the concrete steps taken by
Government to enhance power generation
in the country?
Innovation in Science Pursuit for
Inspired Research Programme
*142. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the aims and objectives of Innovation
in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research
(INSPIRE) Programme;
(b) to what extent INSPIRE helps in
producing more and more science students
and stopping exodus of scientists from
Indian scientific institutions;
(c) whether it has come to the notice of
Government that there has been a fall in
the rate of Ph.D. students in the country
over the last few years; and
(d) if so, to what extent INSPIRE helps
students to take up research?
Encouragement to wind, solar and
hybrid systems
*143. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of NEW AND
RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government encourages
proposals for wind, solar and hybrid
systems for unelectrified villages in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and

(c) how much funds have been released
for such activities by Government to
different States, during the last two years?
Price quoted by BHEL for Sasan
UMPP
*144. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI MOHAMMED AMIN:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to refer to answer to parts (c) to (e) of
Starred Question 29, given in the Rajya
Sabha on the 13th August, 2007 and state:
(a) the exact price quoted by BHEL for
power plant equipments; and
(b) the price quoted in NTPC bid for
Sasan Ultra Mega Power Project (UMPP),
based on the cost of the similar power
equipments previously awarded through
the process of competitive bidding for
NTPC Ltd.?
Financial assistance for working
women's hostels
*145. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) what is the usual time-frame for
sanctioning financial assistance under the
scheme for construction of working
women's hostels;
(b) whether any preference is given, in
view of economic-backwardness of the area
and the prospective users being primarily
poor dalit and adivasi women;
(c) whether any proposal for
construction of such a working women's
hostel at Yavatmal is pending consideration
since August, 2004; and
(d) if so, whether expeditious decision
would be taken?
Power generation
*146. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the total power generated in the
country during this year, till the 31st
October, 2007, in Central, State and private
sectors, separately, vis-a-vis the
stipulations thereof in each case;
(b) the reasons for short-fall in case that
exceeds five per cent of the stipulation;
and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to further augment generation of power in
the country this year?
UN assistance in eradication of
illiteracy
*147. SHRI RAJ KUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the year
2000, UN had promised India and some
other countries to help them in eradication
of illiteracy and for provision of education
to all by 2015;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what is the progress made, so far as
half the time has elapsed; and
(d) the steps being taken to accomplish
the task by 2015?
Registration of new cases in courts

SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number

(b) if so, the details in that regard; and

of cases registered in each category of

Survey of earthquake prone zones
624. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has conducted
any survey of the earthquake prone zones
during the last three years and also during
2007;
(b) if so, the details thereof, zone-wise
and State-wise;
(c) the funds expected to be allocated to
each State and zone during the period; and
(d) how long before the earthquake
taking place would be intimated?
Planning for establishment of food
processing parks
†625. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is fact that Government
has planned to establish food processing
parks in many States;
(b) if so, the details of the parks, State-
wise;
(c) at which places in Rajasthan such
parks have been established or are planned
to be established; and
(d) in what way this plan is financed?
Food processing industries in
Rajasthan
†626. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) the kinds of industries that can be
established in Rajasthan for food
processing;
(b) whether some survey or study has
been conducted in this regard, if so, the
details thereof;
(c) whether there is any scheme under
consideration to ensure that the food
processing takes place at farmer’s family
level;
(d) if not, whether Government with
the co-operation of State Government
would formulate such scheme for each and
every district of Rajasthan; and

(e) whether Government would make
arrangement for some kind of technical and
financial co-operation in the project for
processing of garlic, coriander, cumin seed,
fenu, greek, orange, kinnu, tomato and
lemon produced in the State?
Cold storage facilities
627. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether adequate cold storage
facilities have been created in every district
of the country;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether private operators running
cold storage facilities, are charging huge fees;
and
(d) if so, the action taken to regulate
such facilities?
Setting up of food processing
industries in Sikkim
628. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
set up new food processing industries in
Sikkim during the current year;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of incentives proposed
to be provided to the industrialists who
intend to set up such industries in the State?
Domestic agro processing industry
629. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is proposing
any steps to consolidate the domestic agro
processing industry, comprising a large
number of small players across the country;
(b) if so, the details of the incentives
and promotional steps taken to help the
small and medium entrepreneurs, to
consolidate capacities through mergers and
acquisitions; and
(c) if not, the reasons for failure of
exploiting the sector which has tremendous
potential?
Wastage of fruits
†630. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the total quantum of processable
fruits in the country and the total quantum
of fruits, out of this, which perishes due to
non-utilization;
(b) whether any effective policy has
been framed by Government for utilization
of such fruits that perish in absence of
processing facilities; and
(c) if so, the total quantity of the
produced fruits targeted to be processed in
the country by the end of the Eleventh
Five Year Plan?
Share of Indian food processing industry
in the international market
†631. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the share of Indian food
processing industry in the international
market is unsatisfactory;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto;

152
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether the quantity of export can
be increased by expediting research and
testing work in this industry; and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto and the details of the action plan
therefor?
